Refresh only reloads SPA while host keeps the lock; gives ordered steps stop host → confirm exit → install → verify.
Unpinned name resolves to latest=0.1.1-rc.2 (alpha=0.1.2-alpha.5), silently replacing installed alpha.4; correct mechanism.
Exact pinned alpha.5 install plus TUI, stop-first and dsh --version verify are given, but no explicit host restart step after install.
